title: Breaking the Barrier of Hard Samples: A Data-Centric Approach to Synthetic Data for Medical Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2611.27511v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Data scarcity and quality issues remain significant barriers to developing robust predictive models in medical research. Traditional reliance on real-world data often leads to biased models with poor generalizability across diverse patient populations. Synthetic data generation has emerged as a promising solution, yet challenges related to these samples' representativeness and effective utilization persist. This paper introduces Profile2Gen, a novel data-centric framework designed to guide the generation and refinement of synthetic data, focusing on addressing hard-to-learn samples in regression tasks. We conducted approximately 18,000 experiments to validate its effectiveness across six medical datasets, utilizing seven state-of-the-art generative models. translated_title: 突破困难样本的壁垒：一种面向医疗任务的以数据为中心的合成数据方法
translated_abstract: 数据稀缺和质量问题仍然是医学研究中开发稳健预测模型的重要障碍。传统上对真实世界数据的依赖往往导致模型存在偏差，在多样化的患者群体中泛化能力较差。合成数据生成已成为一种有前景的解决方案，但这些样本的代表性及其有效利用方面的挑战依然存在。本文提出了Profile2Gen，这是一个新颖的以数据为中心的框架，旨在指导合成数据的生成与改进，重点解决回归任务中难以学习的样本。我们进行了约18,000项实验，利用七种最先进的生成模型，在六个医学数据集上验证了该方法的有效性。结果表明，经过改进的合成样本能够降低预测误差并增强模型可靠性。此外，我们还将DataIQ框架泛化以支持回归任务。
tldr: 本文提出以数据为中心的Profile2Gen框架，通过生成与改进合成数据来解决医学回归任务中难以学习的样本问题，并经过约18,000项实验验证，证明改进后的合成样本可降低预测误差并提升模型可靠性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Profile2Gen, a data-centric framework for generating and refining synthetic data to tackle hard-to-learn samples in medical regression tasks, validated through approximately 18,000 experiments showing that refined synthetic samples reduce predictive errors and enhance model reliability.
